circular_plus.meaning: Finite projected field-only Q/P drive, both polarizations/sin-cos; injected distributions measured. Chirality label is profile handedness, NOT identified photon helicity.

circular_minus.meaning: Finite projected field-only Q/P drive, both polarizations/sin-cos; injected distributions measured. Chirality label is profile handedness, NOT identified photon helicity.

momentum.meaning: Exact commuting C3 translation projectors, momenta2pi*r/3 modulo reciprocal lattice; oscillator basis occupation is NOT photon number.
